description: libSQL via Drizzle. Serves both the `turso` profile (hosted, authToken) and the `sqlite` profile (local file: URL) — same client, same dialect, so db-sqlite-extras only has to add pragmas, Litestream and boot migrations.

env.name: TURSO_DATABASE_URL
env.note: libsql://... in production. Local dev and unit tests use file:./.data/dev.db

env.name: TURSO_AUTH_TOKEN
env.note: Required for a hosted libsql:// URL; leave empty for a local file: URL.
